title: This machine
intro: What this node can offer. This profile is sent to your paired machines so that each unit of work goes where it can run.

left_open.one: {n} item of AIODOS data can still be read by other accounts on this machine (a disk without Unix permissions, or a file owned by another account):
left_open.other: {n} items of AIODOS data can still be read by other accounts on this machine (a disk without Unix permissions, or a file owned by another account):

left_open_fix: Move the data folder to a disk that keeps permissions, or fix them by hand.
too_big: too big: runs on the processor (slow)
models_hint: A model larger than the VRAM runs partly on the processor, much more slowly. One of your machines with enough memory can then answer in its place, or several can share it.
no_models_ollama: No models on {here} (or Ollama is not responding).
background_hint: Indexing and computing for your machines come after you: always at low priority (and on Windows, in processor efficiency mode). During a conversation on this machine, work on the graphics card waits until the answer is finished.
battery_help: Save: one unit at a time per resource (graphics card, processor…), fewer threads, and pauses (computing half of the time). Wait: nothing runs in the background until the machine is plugged in again. Conversations are served in every case.
close_to_tray: Keep AIODOS open when I close the window
close_to_tray_help: It stays in the notification area, next to the clock: the node keeps serving your machines and moving background work forward. Click the icon to reopen it, right-click to quit.
autostart_windows: Start with Windows, in the background
autostart_phone_help: The node starts when the phone turns on, without opening the AIODOS app: it runs in the background, with its notification (Android requires it).
autostart_windows_help: When you sign in, AIODOS starts without opening its window: the node serves your machines and moves background work forward; the icon next to the clock reopens the window.
autostart_on: AIODOS will start with this device, in the background.
autostart_off: AIODOS will no longer start with this device.
status_chatting_detail: Work on the graphics card waits until the answer is finished.
network_help: Discovery of other nodes, pairing with a code, encrypted exchanges.
network_off: The local network is off: this PC lends nothing and hands nothing off.
when_idle: Only when I'm not using this PC
when_idle_help: Like a screen saver: work stops as soon as you come back. When off, this PC also lends while you use it: at low priority, never on battery, the graphics card half of the time at most, and your conversations go first.
idle_delay_help: With no keyboard or mouse input for this long, this PC counts as free: lending is no longer held back (with the setting above, it only starts then).
min_battery_help: To start computing (then it pauses 5% lower): below that, the phone charges first.
max_temp_help: Above it, pause until the battery has cooled down by 3 °C.
offload: Get help from my other machines
offload_help: Units of your tasks can be computed on your paired machines, except libraries kept on {device}. Results are saved here.
share: Lend my computing power to my other machines
share_help_phone: This phone computes for them without keeping anything: received files are deleted right away.
share_help_pc: This PC computes for them without keeping anything: received files are deleted right away.
lend_models: Lend my models for their conversations
lend_models_help: Their conversations can be answered by the models of {device}. The text passes through here, encrypted, while the answer is written, without being saved; your background work pauses meanwhile.
lend_public: Lend my computing power to strangers' conversations
lend_public_help: People on the public network, who don't say who they are, can have their conversations answered by the models of {device}, one at a time, after your machines and your friends. Never on battery; whatever you do comes first and stops their answer. Their text passes through here while the answer is written, without being saved.
lend_public_help_phone: People on the public network, who don't say who they are, can have their conversations answered by the models of this phone, one at a time, after your machines and your friends: only while charging and on Wi-Fi. Their text passes through here while the answer is written, without being saved.
lend_gpu: Lend my graphics card for large models
lend_gpu_help: A model too large for a single machine is split across my machines: this one keeps a slice of it for the length of a conversation, through an encrypted tunnel of the companion. Only for my machines, never for a friend; both sides need the same version of llama.cpp.
lend_images: Lend my graphics card to my friends for images
lend_images_help: When this PC lends its computing power, it can also compute images and videos for your friends who ask it to. Their description and the result pass through here while it computes, without being kept.
ac_only_phone_help: Never on battery. A phone's idle time can't be measured: charging is what counts.
lend_power_help_pc: Never the whole machine: this share sets how many computations this PC runs at once and how much of its graphics card's time it lends. The rest stays yours, even while it computes for others.
lend_power_help_phone: Never the whole phone: this share sets how many computations it runs at once, with pauses in between. It heats up less.
rename_ask_text: The name that will identify this machine on your network:
autostart_unsupported: Start with the device: only on Windows and Android.
use_public: Have my conversations computed by strangers
use_public_help: In automatic mode, a machine on the public network can answer your conversations without knowing who you are: after your machines, or before {device} if it is twice as fast. Never your attachments; your documents only with your consent. “On my machines only”, in Permissions under the message box, keeps a conversation with you.
public_bigger_model: Use a bigger model from the public network
public_bigger_model_help: In automatic mode, a machine on the public network that has a bigger model than the chosen one (qwen3.5:9b rather than 0.8b) answers instead.
public_documents: Send passages from my documents to the public network
public_documents_help: When an answer relies on your libraries, the useful passages go with the conversation to the stranger's machine; never the conversation memory, nor the libraries kept on this machine. Without consent, such a conversation stays on your machines.
not_asked: Not asked yet: the question will come up in a conversation, the first time.
lend_images_public: Lend my graphics card to strangers' images and videos
lend_images_public_help: People on the public network, who don't say who they are, can have their images and videos created by {device}, one at a time, under the same rules as their conversations: after your machines and your friends, never on battery, and whatever you do comes first. A video keeps the card busy for several minutes, followed by the lent-power pause. Their description and what is created pass through here while it computes, without being saved.
lend_images_public_help_phone: People on the public network, who don't say who they are, can have their images and videos created by this phone, one at a time, after your machines and your friends: only while charging and on Wi-Fi. Their description and what is created pass through here while it computes, without being saved.
public_images: Create my images and videos through the public network
public_images_help: When neither this machine nor your machines can create an image or a video, a stranger's machine on the public network creates it: it reads your description and sees what it creates, without knowing who you are. Never an attached image; “On my machines only” keeps a conversation with you.
